transcript.text: Good afternoon, this is Mumbai Bank calling regarding your credit card. We’ve noticed your payment is overdue. I’m here to help you resolve this quickly—could you please let me know when you’ll be able to make the payment? Please note, non-payment may negatively affect your credit score and could lead to legal action. If you’re facing any difficulties, I can assist you with options.
Mujhe English samajh nahi aati. Hindi mein baat kijiye.

Namaste, main Mumbai Bank se bol raha hoon. Aapke credit card ka payment due hai. Kripya bataiye, aap kab tak payment kar payenge? Agar aapko payment karne mein koi dikkat ho rahi hai, toh main aapki madad kar sakta hoon. Dhyaan rahe, payment nahi karne se aapka credit score kharab ho sakta hai aur kanooni karwai ho sakti hai.
Namaste, mujhe thoda samay chahiye payment karne ke liye. Kya aap mujhe thoda samay de sakte hain?

Bilkul, main samajh sakta hoon ki kabhi-kabhi payment mein samasya aa sakti hai. Kripya bataiye, aapko kitne din ka samay chahiye payment karne ke liye? Main aapki request ko record kar lunga.

Aapko yaad rahe, agar aap time par payment nahi karte hain, toh late fee ₹1500 ka lag sakta hai aur interest bhi lagta rahega. Agar aapko kisi aur tarah ki madad chahiye ya koi discount chahiye, toh aap pooch sakte hain.

Kripya apna commitment de dijiye ki aap kab tak payment karenge?
Mujhe 15 din ka samay chahiye payment karne ke liye. Kya yeh theek rahega?
